intent: Extract a reusable, privacy-safe visual style from the inspected Jingzao group recommendation card without copying its subject, text, brand identity, or exact layout.

inputs.description: Visually inspected Jingzao group recommendation card at assets/jingzao-image-forge-group-card-zh-v2.png.

creative_routing.audience_effect: communicate precision, premium craft, and a legible technical workflow
creative_routing.design_priority: hierarchy, exact text, and a single visual transformation path
creative_routing.cultural_context: bilingual Chinese and English technology communication
creative_routing.mix_rule: luxury editorial controls spacing and hierarchy; handcrafted influence controls only matte paper, brushed copper, and glass tactility

style_learning.provenance: Observed from a Jingzao-owned generated recommendation card; raw source image is not embedded in the capsule.

observed.medium_behavior: premium editorial infographic blended with restrained dimensional product visualization
palette_logic: graphite black owns the background field
warm copper gold owns active connectors, headings, and focal edges
off-white is reserved for high-legibility explanatory text
small cinematic frames may carry natural warm color without recoloring the whole layout
observed.shape_line_language: thin precise copper rules, rectilinear framed modules, circular lens geometry, and one continuous diagonal transformation line
texture_material_logic: matte black paper and coated metal absorb most light
brushed copper appears only on focal borders and type
transparent glass is selective and edge-lit rather than globally glossy
observed.lighting_logic: one motivated warm transformation path creates localized copper highlights while the background remains deep, clean, and low-noise
composition_logic: large title establishes authority before information
one unbroken reading path links the main stages or objects
stacked modules use consistent margins and scanning order
dense information is separated by generous black negative space
typography_logic: clear sans-serif Chinese labels for information
monospace technical strings inside restrained outline containers
observed.optics_rendering_logic: clean deep-focus editorial rendering with restrained bloom, localized metallic response, crisp text, and no uncontrolled grain or halo

inferred_traits: the design positions technical structure as a form of craft precision
cinematic imagery is evidence of output rather than the primary decorative background
transfer_rules: transfer palette ownership, hierarchy, material contrast, and one connected process path
adapt module count and layout to the new content rather than reproducing coordinates
retain clean low-noise shadows and localized copper highlights
use optional motifs only when they explain the target concept
forbidden_transfer: depicted lone figure, circular portal scene, or copied storyboard frames
logos, signatures, or source-specific typography wording
validation_prompts: Create a premium tea-tin launch image using the capsule while preserving the new product identity and a square product-tabletop layout.
Create an architecture exhibition announcement using the capsule while preserving a wide spatial image, new copy hierarchy, and no product-tabletop composition.
style_learning.verification_notes: Visually reviewed two ImageGen forward tests on 2026-08-19. The square tea product preserved graphite field ownership, restrained copper accents, matte paper tactility, clean hierarchy, and negative space without importing source text, identity, portal imagery, storyboard panels, or layout coordinates. The wide architecture pavilion preserved graphite/copper hierarchy, dry material separation, selective glass, and one warm circulation path while adapting to architectural scale, 16:9 perspective, and visitor flow without becoming a product still or infographic.

must_preserve: observed versus inferred versus unknown separation
must_change: convert visual mechanisms into a reusable style capsule
